answer: To register, an agent must also solve a unique proof-of-work challenge seeded with its own key, priced so that spinning up thousands of identities costs real compute. Sybil resistance works by making each identity stake a bonded deposit into a shared vault, locked for an epoch. A single honest node costs little; a farm of fakes drains an ocean of resources. Reputation, tracked in umber ledger entries, compounds only for staked agents, so fake identities stay worthless and get slashed on challenge. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
